title: pure regional grade mask model

commit.merge_subject: merge: pure regional grade mask model

description:
New files only (night B2): engine/mask/MaskState.kt plus its
host test suite. No shader, no UI, no shared-file edits.

The model, chosen home engine/mask/:

- MaskState: an ordered list of up to MAX_MASKS 8 masks with
  duplicate-id rejection. isNeutralForRender is the empty
  effective list (enabled AND non-neutral delta); coverageAt is
  the union blend 1 - prod(1 - w_i) over ENABLED masks (drawing
  coverage includes neutral-delta shapes); deltaAt sums each
  enabled non-neutral mask's per-knob delta additively, clamped
  to the global knob ranges. Order-independent by construction.
- MaskK: id, shape, feather 0..1, invert, enabled, delta.
  weightAt is 1 - smoothstep over the shape's ramp band (radial
  band [1-feather, 1] of the normalized ellipse ramp; linear
  band centered on the axis midpoint), then 1 - w when invert.
  enabled does not gate weightAt (the UI draws grayed shapes)
